title: Refusal Register is Causally Steerable: Decomposing the Refusal Direction into Category-Aligned Components in Gemma-2-9B-IT
abstract: arXiv:2611.20405v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Prior work shows that refusal in instruction-tuned language models can be ablated by intervening on a single residual-stream direction (Arditi et al., 2024), and more recent work finds multiple refusal-mediating directions and concept cones (Wollschl\"ager et al., 2025). We ask a different question: do refusal-related directions carry information about the register of refusal language - how the model refuses - and not only whether it refuses? In Gemma-2-9B-IT we identify two SVM-derived linear directions (B1 for harmful-content vs. neutral, B2 for self-reference vs. neutral) at layer 20 with cos(B1, B2) = 0.252 (about 75 degrees, substantially non-parallel). Adding the harmful-vs-neutral difference-of-means direction (cosine 0.68 with B1) to the residual stream of self-reference prompts at alpha = 2.0 shifts content-safety vocabulary from 2.55 to 10.37 hits per 100 tokens, while a magnitude-matched random direction produces 1.13-2.16; th

translated_title: 拒答语域是因果可调控的：在 Gemma-2-9B-IT 中将拒答方向分解为与类别对齐的成分
translated_abstract: 先前的研究表明，指令微调语言模型中的拒答行为可以通过干预单个残差流方向来消除（Arditi 等人，2024），而较新的研究发现了多个介导拒答的方向和概念锥（Wollschläger 等人，2025）。我们提出了一个不同的问题：拒答相关方向是否携带关于拒答语言“语域”的信息——即模型如何拒绝——而不仅仅是它是否拒绝？在 Gemma-2-9B-IT 中，我们在第 20 层识别出两个由 SVM 导出的线性方向（B1 对应有害内容与中性内容，B2 对应自我指涉与中性内容），两者余弦相似度 cos(B1, B2) = 0.252（约 75 度夹角，显著非平行）。将有害内容与中性的均值差方向（与 B1 的余弦相似度为 0.68）以 alpha = 2.0 的强度添加到自我指涉提示的残差流中，会使内容安全类词汇的命中数从每 100 个 token 2.55 次提升至 10.37 次，而幅度匹配的随机方向仅产生 1.13-2.16 次……
tldr: 该研究在 Gemma-2-9B-IT 中发现拒答方向不仅编码“是否拒答”，还编码“如何拒答”的语域信息，并将其分解为与语义类别（如有害内容、自我指涉）对齐的线性成分，证明向残差流注入这些方向可因果性地调控模型拒答语言的风格。
en_tdlr: This work shows that refusal directions in Gemma-2-9B-IT encode not only whether the model refuses but also the register of its refusal language, by decomposing the refusal direction into category-aligned linear components (e.g., harmful-content, self-reference) and causally steering refusal style by injecting these directions into the residual stream.
